en: Fold-out postcard with a printed map of the Pécs Zoo (Állatkert) and surroundings in Pécs, Hungary. One side shows a colorful illustrated plan of the zoo with animal drawings (tiger, snake, birds, bison, deer, otter, wolf, etc.), paths, buildings, enclosures and labels for features such as the aquarium, terrarium, education room, entrance and nearby streets. The reverse side has typical postcard layout with address lines, stamp boxes, printed ticket information and opening hours for the zoo and adjacent amusement park, along with the location name 'Mecseki Kultúrpark, Pécs'.
